Delhi Sultanate.subject: Medieval & Modern India
Delhi Sultanate.question: What is Delhi Sultanate? Late medieval empire in the Indian subcontinent (1206–1526).
Delhi Sultanate.fact: The Delhi Sultanate or the Sultanate of Delhi was a late medieval empire primarily based in Delhi that stretched over large parts of the Indian subcontinent for more than three centuries.

Delhi Sultanate.subject: Medieval & Modern India
Delhi Sultanate.question: Khalji and _____ rule ushered a new wave of rapid and continual Muslim conquests deep into South India

Delhi Sultanate.fact: It was called the "Empire of Delhi" (Persian: Mamalik-i-Delhi) by Minhaj-i Siraj Juzjani and Ziauddin Barani, while Ibn Battuta referred to the empire under Muhammad bin Tughlaq as "Hind and Sind".
